crew.overview: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.
crew.title: Sinners

details.biography:
Rebecca Cho is a film executive serving as Senior Vice President of Film Development and Production at Proximity Media.

Before joining Proximity Media, Cho was a Development Director at Warner Bros., instrumental in developing several high-profile films. She collaborated with the Proximity team on Judas and the Black Messiah and Space Jam: A New Legacy. Her additional credits at Warner Bros. include Clouds, the critically acclaimed King Richard starring Will Smith, Wonka starring Timothée Chalamet, Greta Gerwig and Margot Robbie’s Barbie, and Furiosa, the anticipated prequel to Mad Max: Fury Road directed by George Miller.

Cho began her entertainment career after graduating from UC Irvine, gaining early experience at Fox 2000 and ABC Studios.
details.name: Rebecca Cho
